title: Effective rank of ΔC (C - C_init) — last tile, by LRTT rank
target_layers: QKVO (attention Q, K, V, output projections)
metric: erank(C - C_init): effective rank of weight change matrix relative to initialization

condition.optimization: per-rank optimized (each rank independently optimized via Optuna)

note: erank(C - C_init) measures complexity of learned weight update. Higher effective rank indicates richer, more distributed learned representation.
